title: The Joke Remembered from Yesterday
youtube_title: The Joke Remembered from Yesterday | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who helped, and helping back, keeps a home kind.
summary: At a bedroom with the hall light still on, Idris notices that Grandma Nia has already taken care of a joke remembered and handed back today. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Idris does one useful thing Grandma Nia did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
